description: This file is the entry point for a React-based front-end application. It imports React, ReactDOM, CSS styles, and the main App component, then renders the App component into the DOM element with id 'root' within a React.StrictMode wrapper.

methods.name: ReactDOM.createRoot
methods.description: Creates a root for rendering a React component tree into a DOM node.

methods.name: root.render
methods.description: Renders the React component tree into the root DOM node.
